description: I’m passionate about aerospace, astrophysics, physics and engineering. Through Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) , I’ve explored Arduino, electronics, 3D printing, RC aircraft, rocket prototypes and turbojet models. I enjoy turning unconventional ideas into practical projects, researching problems and collaborating across disciplines. I’m looking for teammates skilled in programming, CAD, data science, engineering, design and research who are curious, creative and willing to experiment.
summary:
An intelligent health monitoring and prediction app specifically for astronauts focusing on women’s health, including their menstrual and reproductive health.

We found there was a lack of data regarding changes in menstrual cycles in space. To overcome this, we created an exploratory data-set by combining known physiological changes that occur in space with existing biological knowledge of the menstrual cycle.

The app allows the user to record health data, monitor their menstrual cycle, view predictions and track changes in their health throughout time. It also includes a menstrual product predictor and extra modules to help track heart rate, sleep and musculoskeletal health.

Our aim is to increase inclusivity within space healthcare and improve astronaut health planning.

As we were students at school we have used what we knew, had available and had time for. Some of the features will not be fully completed however we will continue to improve on the app and improve predictions to make the features more reliable.
details:
AstraHealth is an app that allows users to monitor and predict their health data focused around women's reproductive health.

We did some research and found that there was a lack of data on how the menstrual cycle could be impacted in space. So we developed our own data set of exploratory data using known physiological changes that occur in space and general biological knowledge of the menstrual cycle.

We can use this data within our app to monitor and log different areas of your health including your menstrual cycle. The app also has other modules within it to monitor different areas of your health such as heart rate, sleep and musculoskeletal.

The app was built using Flutter and Dart within Visual Studio Code. We have also used Firebase to provide services.

The aim of this application is to increase awareness of this often overlooked area of health care for astronauts. We took into consideration the lack of research data, individual differences in health, data security and difficulties that astronauts may encounter over long periods in space.
dataRefs: Long Term Space Flight Impacts on Female Reproductive Health (OS-684)
